business_problem: Sensei is a wellbeing retreat company that wanted to consolidate and integrate several third-party software tools while embracing secure use of generative AI.
solution_summary: Sensei is a wellbeing retreat company that wanted to consolidate and integrate several third-party software tools while embracing secure use of generative AI. The company rolled out Microsoft 365 to reduce the number of internal apps and better connect systems for easier collaboration. This helped make employees more efficient and reduced routine tasks. Sensei deployed Microsoft 365 company-wide,then expanded with Microsoft 365 Copilot to a test group across business functions. When practitioners help guests, Microsoft 365 Copilot pulls vetted data on approved wellness practices from Microsoft SharePoint and other connected apps, for a tailored experience. Sensei uses Microsoft Defender for Office 365 to secure communication in email and collaboration tools, and Microsoft Defender for Business to strengthen endpoint protection across operating systems on company-issued Windows and Macintosh laptops. solution_components.name: Microsoft Defender for Office 365
solution_components.role: Protects email and collaboration channels used in daily operations.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Defender for Business
solution_components.role: Centralizes endpoint security and management for company-issued devices.

business_outcome: Microsoft 365 Copilot improves my productivity and focus. I spend less time documenting meeting outcomes and more time in a creative space.

evidence_quotes: Sensei is a wellbeing retreat company that wanted to consolidate and integrate several third-party software tools while embracing secure use of generative AI.
The company rolled out Microsoft 365 to reduce the number of internal apps and better connect systems for easier collaboration. This helped make employees more efficient and reduced routine tasks.
Sensei deployed Microsoft 365 company-wide,then expanded with Microsoft 365 Copilot to a test group across business functions.

When practitioners help guests, Microsoft 365 Copilot pulls vetted data on approved wellness practices from Microsoft SharePoint and other connected apps, for a tailored experience. Sensei uses Microsoft Defender for Office 365 to secure communication in email and collaboration tools, and Microsoft Defender for Business to strengthen endpoint protection across operating systems on company-issued Windows and Macintosh laptops. These solutions help maintain compliance with industry regulations, with Defender for Business providing unified security tools and centralized management, which helps the small IT department support the company.
